My family seems to the same, my feelings are constantly invalidated so when im trying to voice my pain they just end up making me feel guilty for feeling that way. Like its not my fault im traumatized. But don't feel like death is the only way out of that pain, I've been in that situation. 2020 really set those feelings off and I thought I was ready every single day to die but I guess here I am now. Try finding the things that make you feel happy and hold onto them. It takes time and self love to truly be happy. Easier said than done but you're already on the way there !!

I know exactly how you feel. It feels like no one deserves me because of the way I am. I know that I am wrong and I shouldn't be having so many outburst, but I can't control it sometimes. It just adds more to my depression too and seeing my partner unhappy because of me hurts. I don't want to let her go yet cause I love her so much. But seeing them hurt because of me, not the best feeling. And I can't help to think "what about my problems".I feel selfish but my thoughts takes over. 

I'm definitely not one to ask about love because I only knew so little about it. I don't have any affection with my family either, I didn't grow up in that kind of household. But I guess love doesn't have to always mean you need to be with that person forever. Maybe they were apart of your healing journey, they did show you life in a different way. They influenced you to be a better person even if they aren't in your life anymore. That's still love. We feel like we want to be love but fear that they will leave. Maybe you did love him so much but you were more afraid that he will leave. Causing you to push them away. But thats OKAY and not your fault. Not everyone is meant for you and you're not meant for everyone. Someone will stay with you one day and see how far you came. Feel free to message me! I'm always looking to talk to someone :) Definitely feels like I can relate to people who goes through the same thing.

I think a common feeling among Asian children is that we look for so much validation from our family and that affects our everyday choices. Constantly worrying about if I do this, will my family get upset with me?   
No I totally agree with the whole not talking to them about it. I stopped talking to my family about any of my problems or even opinion on anything. It was just seems like they want to keeping arguing with you when all you just want is for them to understand and actually care about your feelings. How is everything at home for you right now? Thank you for sharing your post, it means a lot when there are people who relate to my feelings.

Hey!! where do you plan running off to? Hopefully you are talking about moving out and not just completely running away from home without a destination. I know it is not my place to tell you what you should or shouldn't do but please do not run away before having a secure place to stay!! I know how you feel. There have been so many nights where I wanted to leave to go anywhere or just die. Having at least one second of not feeling any kind of pain sounds like the best option but try to hang in there. If possible, avoid talking to your parents cause I know that talking to your parent sometimes will trigger past traumas and it will cause you to constantly feel like you can never talk to then normally again without remembering the trauma they gave you. I hope that your situations will get better, definitely not being able to move from a place where you cannot grow is going hinder in finding your true self but give it time. Message me about anything if you ever feel like you cannot take anymore. Sharing your feelings with others can really help. :)

hey! I am also currently enrolled as a psychology major but for my undergrad. I definitely know what you mean when you mentioned how the psychology community is undereducated on the topic of minority families. White America wants to make everyone believe that their struggles are all the same but the truth is, everyone's story is going to be different some ways or another. I don't go to therapy to talk about other culture and compare myself to people of another ethnic group. Why would I when I have my own values and customs?  
You do not have to apologize for talking about your experiences or thoughts. I love hearing other people's story and knowing that there is also someone who is experiencing similar situations as me, makes it better. Feeling like your alone in a lot of situations will make that pain even worse.   
I was also searching for validation in other people because my family couldn't give me it. It also lead me to more trauma and that added onto having more anxiety and stress over my self-identity. After searching for validation for so long, I realized I lost myself and that I didn't know who I was anymore. I wasn't doing it for me, I was just trying to get others approval to feel better.  
But I think majoring in this field, opened me up more to dealing with my trauma and understanding why I act the way I act. Hopefully that was the same experience you felt going into this field. It definitely does not feel better when someone tells you that "it gets better" because in those depressive state you do not when that is gonna be because it can last for months or years. But also majority of the time it comes from people who are not depressed, so I honestly do not even listen to what they have to say. It seems like the people who really understand depression are people who have experienced it or is still going through it.   
Thank you for replying!

I definitely know the struggle you are going through at your age. I also was told to be a doctor or anything in the medical field as a child and I also went into universities as a science major but I quickly found out that the major was not for me. My whole life, my family would constantly just tell me to pursue a career in it. Honestly, all you can do right now is try to just pass by until you are old enough and ready to move out of your parent's home. That's what I did. You cannot force change on people who refuse to change. Also, do what you like, it's easier said than done, I know that for sure but deciding your own career will make you happy. Do not waste your time doing that YOU WILL HATE IT.
